tour.welcome: Welcome to this little tutorial. Let's begin to see how to play this game.
tour.team: This is your team ! You begin with 2 characters. If they win battles, characters will level up and get stronger.
tour.hp: This is the life points of your team : if it comes to 0, you fail the battle.
tour.mp: This is the magic points of your team. You need them to use magic.
tour.limit: When you get damaged, this gauge will fill up. When it gets full, your next attack will be overkill !
tour.enemies: This is where the enemy will appears. To win the battle, you have to kill them before they do.
tour.fight: Click here to fight enemies. During the battle, click Attack as many times as you want to defeat them faster, or escape if the enemies are too strong.
tour.materias: This is your magic ! Don't forget you need MP to use them. For example, you can use 'Restore' to cure your characters.
tour.menu: This is the main menu. You can buy new items at the shop, handle your inventory, save your party, etc.
tour.zone: Your are actually into this zone. There is a hidden boss in each zones. Find it and kill it to go next zone !
tour.end: Well, that's all ! Thanks for your attention ! Good luck and have fun ;)
